description: Deploy ROSA (Red Hat OpenShift Service on AWS) HCP cluster with kube-burner-ocp for performance testing
author: Performance Engineering

prerequisites.overview: This deployment requires CLI tools, cloud credentials, and sufficient AWS quotas. All tools must be installed on the machine running agentic-perf.

required_tools.description: Red Hat OpenShift Service on AWS CLI - manages ROSA cluster lifecycle

post_install.note: Will prompt for Red Hat OpenShift token from https://console.redhat.com/openshift/token/rosa

deployment_steps.name: Configure Bastion for Testing
deployment_steps.description: Install tools and configure bastion instance for kube-burner execution

commands.command: aws ssm send-command --region {{region}} --instance-ids {{bastion_instance_id}} --document-name AWS-RunShellScript --parameters commands='sudo yum install -y git wget tar jq'
commands.note: Installs basic tools needed for kube-burner
Base64 encoded kubeconfig for transfer to bastion

commands.description: Transfer kubeconfig to bastion via SSM
commands.command: aws ssm send-command --region {{region}} --instance-ids {{bastion_instance_id}} --document-name AWS-RunShellScript --parameters commands='mkdir -p ~/.kube && echo {{kubeconfig_b64}} | base64 -d > ~/.kube/config && chmod 600 ~/.kube/config'
aws ssm start-session --region {{region}} --target {{bastion_instance_id}} --document-name AWS-StartNonInteractiveCommand --parameters command='oc whoami && oc get nodes'
commands.validation: Should show cluster-admin and list nodes

deployment_steps.name: Install kube-burner-ocp
deployment_steps.description: Deploy kube-burner on bastion instance for performance testing

commands.command: aws ssm send-command --region {{region}} --instance-ids {{bastion_instance_id}} --document-name AWS-RunShellScript --parameters commands='mkdir -p ~/kube-burner-ocp/bin && cd ~/kube-burner-ocp/bin && curl -L https://github.com/kube-burner/kube-burner-ocp/releases/latest/download/kube-burner-ocp-linux-amd64 -o kube-burner-ocp && chmod +x kube-burner-ocp'

aws ssm send-command --region {{region}} --instance-ids {{bastion_instance_id}} --document-name AWS-RunShellScript --parameters commands='cat > ~/run-kube-burner.sh <<EOF
#!/bin/bash
export KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/config
~/kube-burner-ocp/bin/kube-burner-ocp \$@
EOF
chmod +x ~/run-kube-burner.sh'

commands.description: Verify all cluster operators are healthy
commands.command: oc get clusteroperators -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.status.conditions[] | select(.type=="Available" and .status!="True")) | .metadata.name'
oc get nodes --no-headers | awk '{print $2}' | grep -v Ready
echo 'Bastion SSH: ssh ec2-user@{{bastion_public_ip}}' && echo 'Bastion SSM: aws ssm start-session --region {{region}} --target {{bastion_instance_id}}'

stages: triage_pending → awaiting_hardware (agent verifies AWS credentials and quota)
awaiting_hardware → preparing_platform (agent provisions VPC and networking)
executing_benchmark → awaiting_review (agent runs tests and collects metrics)
awaiting_review → closed (agent analyzes results and reports)

agent_responsibilities.triage_agent: Parse user request for cluster size, region, version, and test scenarios
agent_responsibilities.resource_agent: Verify AWS credentials, check ROSA quota, validate region availability
agent_responsibilities.provisioning_agent: Execute deployment steps, handle errors, validate each stage
agent_responsibilities.benchmark_agent: Run kube-burner workloads, monitor progress, collect logs
agent_responsibilities.review_agent: Parse kube-burner metrics, compare against baselines, generate report
